currency_policy: Native price unit never implies INR/USD; explicit currency requires cited currency metadata.
direction_policy: Only forecast_return_pct permits signed return or positive downside magnitude. Negative upside is rejected; no arbitrary conversions.
fact_text_policy: Empty text, UI renders validated tuple. Interpretation fields null; cautious prose with strict numeric and known-state checks.
numeric_policy: Exact finite JSON number, Decimal equality; bool and string numbers forbidden.
state_policy: Exact source string with state/text unit; no prose, fuzzy matching or implicit state mapping.
